results.question: Giá bán trung bình theo danh mục sản phẩm là bao nhiêu?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(AVG(p.unit_price), 2) AS average_price
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY average_price DESC, c.name ASC;
results.validated_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(CAST(AVG(p.unit_price) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_price FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY average_price DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 201

results.question: Doanh thu hàng hóa theo danh mục là bao nhiêu?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name, 
    ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status <> 'đã hủy'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name ASC;
results.validated_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'đã hủy' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 201

results.question: Năm sản phẩm bán ra nhiều nhất theo số lượng là những sản phẩm nào?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status != 'đã hủy'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.name ASC
LIMIT 5;
results.validated_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'đã hủy' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.name ASC LIMIT 5

results.question: Số đơn theo tháng trong năm 2026 là bao nhiêu?
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date)
ORDER BY month, order_count DESC;
results.validated_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) ORDER BY month, order_count DESC LIMIT 201
